mutants.detail: FAIL ci-policy test-exclusion: build/test-infrastructure/not-executed-inventory.json is missing; the required categories would have no binding list of what they skip. The runner rejects the category for the same reason, so removing the census cannot make a run greener.

mutants.mutation: Report a census that is not bound to the categories it claims to describe
mutants.detail: Each category entry names its test project and the number of [Explicit] attributes that project carries. A census that does not match the sources it claims to describe is rejected.

mutants.mutation: Inventory a due case as not executed
mutants.detail: FAIL ci-policy test-exclusion: category 'rabbitmq' lists a due case as not executed. A due case is run, never inventoried. Covered by test_rejects_inventorying_a_due_case_as_not_executed.

mutants.mutation: Silence a due case with [Ignore], or add an [Explicit] the census does not know
mutants.detail: [Ignore] is rejected outright, a new [Explicit] breaks the bound attribute count, and at run time any not executed case the census does not name fails its category. Covered by test_rejects_ignoring_a_required_case and test_rejects_a_new_explicit_case_that_is_not_inventoried.
